d:
The Raptors defeated the Bucks, 121-107 tonight in Milwaukee. RJ Barrett finished with a team-high 27 points along with 7 rebounds and 5 assists for the Raptors, while Alijah Martin tallied 27 points, 6 three pointers and 4 rebounds in the game. Tyler Herro recorded 23 points, 10 assists and 5 rebounds. The Raptors improve their record to 5-4 with the win, while the Bucks fall to 1-8 for the season.
